eventTemplate.title: [Camunda Application] ConnectorsLogsErrorsDetected
eventTemplate.description:
Connectors service is logging errors for 20 minutes (ConnectorJobHandler excluded) in namespace {dims}.

The source rule also filters job="connectors-service" — that's a Prometheus scrape-target label, not a metric dimension, so it has no equivalent on the native OTLP push path; this relies on logback.events.total only being emitted by the Connectors runtime in your tenant. If several services share this metric, add a filter on service.name (or another resource attribute) to scope it.

Assumes the Connectors runtime pushes OTLP the same way Zeebe does — same caveat as connectors-queue-overflow.json. If collector-scraped instead, use the underscored key `logback_events_total`.

IMPORTANT: the logger dimension exclusion only works if Advanced OTLP metric dimensions is enabled (otherwise dimension keys are lowercased and this filter won't match) — see dynatrace/runbook-dynatrace.md step 2.
